relations.subject: Braj Basi Lal
relations.evidence: Lal obtained his master's degree in Sanskrit from Allahabad University, India.

relations.subject: Braj Basi Lal
relations.evidence: in 1943, became a trainee in excavation under a veteran British archaeologist, Mortimer Wheeler, starting with Taxila, and later at sites such as Harappa.

relations.subject: Braj Basi Lal
relations.evidence: In 1968, he was appointed the Director General of the Archaeological Survey of India where he would remain until 1972.

relations.subject: Braj Basi Lal
relations.object: Indian Institute of Advanced Studies, Shimla
relations.evidence: Thereafter, Lal served as Director of the Indian Institute of Advanced Studies, Shimla.

relations.subject: Braj Basi Lal
relations.role: Head of Department in School of Studies in Archaeology
relations.evidence: He served as Head of Department in School of Studies in Archaeology, Jiwaji University, Gwalior from 1970 to 1975.

relations.subject: KK Mohammed
relations.evidence: KK Mohammed, who was a student archaeologist accompanying BB Lal.
